plan.title: Draft Add Columns Hidden When Vendor Lock Is Off

steps.note: Open the Events list to reach the saved drafts.
Enable eRFX project creation as required by the case.
Apply the setting whose effect on the draft's Add Columns control is being tested.
Apply the additional company configuration required by the test setup.
Verify the events list rendered before navigating to drafts.
Switch to the Drafts tab specified by the case.
Open the first saved draft, which is the available saved-draft target for this plan.
Assert the Add Columns control is not offered on the saved eRFX draft.
